scope: Unchanged Windows SDK PE32 EXE translated in browser with real Wine base libraries. Window hierarchy, immediate-child hit testing with POINT-by-value, skip flags, top-window z-order, nested versus owned windows, aliased RECT geometry and output guards. Native transparent custom children paint after underlying siblings through actual guest callbacks; window state changes and cleanup; loose EXE and ZIP upload. No claim of full USER32 conformance.
